scripts.companion:check: cd apps/companion && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.companion:build: cd apps/companion && flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi && node ../../scripts/sync-companion-release.mjs app-arm64-v8a-release.apk
scripts.companion:build:qa: cd apps/companion && flutter build apk --debug && node ../../scripts/sync-companion-release.mjs app-debug.apk
scripts.build: pnpm run companion:build && pnpm run desktop:build
scripts.qa:production: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm --dir apps/desktop check && pnpm --dir apps/desktop build && pnpm run companion:check && pnpm run companion:build:qa
